title: Swobodnie
audience: Teenagers from 13 and adults. Themes of general interest: people, media, travel, study and work, health, technology, environment, culture, society. Suitable for a 13-year-old (no alcohol, violence or sexual content), without assuming the learner has a job or a family of their own.
vocabGuide: Genuinely B1-B2 on the CEFR scale: the vocabulary that takes a learner from getting by to speaking comfortably: common phrasal verbs, strong collocations, frequent idioms in current use, word families. No A2 basics, no C1 rarities.
